{{Quote|Perhaps there is a madness in remaining on Tython while not strong in the Force. One would not submerge long beneath the surface of the sea if one did not possess gills. One would surface. One would escape. So to stay here, now ... that way, insanity lies.|Unknown Tythan|<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>}}
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''27,453 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''', also known as '''9,000 TYA''', was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] in the [[pre-Republic era]]. Around that year, an unknown [[Tythan]] was recorded discussing the thought of a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] living on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and the Tythan's words were well-known over a thousand years later.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
